convention.en: If the government loses such a vote, convention says the Prime Minister must either resign or call a general election.
convention.zh: 如果政府在这样的投票中失利，按惯例首相必须辞职或解散议会重新大选。

convention.en: British politics is unusual. It’s old, it’s full of quirky traditions, and it’s based far more on customs and conventions than on a single written rulebook.
convention.zh: 英国政治很不寻常。它历史悠久，充满了奇特的传统，而且它更多地基于习俗和惯例，而不是一本单一的成文规则手册。

cooperate.en: These countries cooperate on decisions, even if they’re not officially part of OPEC itself.
cooperate.zh: 这些国家在决策上进行合作，即使它们并非OPEC本身的正式成员。

cooperate.en: What do you think? Do you think countries should cooperate to control prices of things like oil?
cooperate.zh: 你怎么看？你认为各国应该合作控制像石油这样的东西的价格吗？

cooperate.en: I think that culture and religion or good cooperating systems for humans.
cooperate.zh: 我认为文化和宗教是人类良好的合作系统。

cooperate.en: Sure, the United States does not cooperate with terrorists.
cooperate.zh: 当然，美国是不会与恐怖分子合作的。

cooperate.en: The most common game played is one called a stag's hunt, where if we cooperate, we can bring down a big stag and both have big dinners.
cooperate.zh: 最常见的游戏被称为“牡鹿猎取”（Stag Hunt），如果我们合作，我们可以猎杀一头大鹿，两人都能享用丰盛的晚餐。

corporation.en: Governments and large corporations are also building systems and platforms based on AI.
corporation.zh: 政府和大型企业也在构建基于AI的系统和平台。

corporation.en: It was not black tie. It was put on by the Neighborhood Assistance Corporation of America.
corporation.zh: 那不是黑领带晚宴。它是由美国邻里援助协会举办的。

corporation.en: The offices of NACA, the Neighborhood Assistance Corporation of America in Newark, New Jersey are short on frills.
corporation.zh: 位于新泽西州纽瓦克的美国国家住房援助公司（NACA）的办公室没有什么华丽的装潢。

corporation.en: Without a fair minimum wage, the most vulnerable in society risk being even more exploited by powerful corporations.
corporation.zh: 如果没有合理的最低工资，社会中最弱势的群体就有可能受到强大公司更严重的剥削。

corporation.en: This is what “universitas” originally meant, not “a university” as we think of today, but a corporation of students.
corporation.zh: 这就是“universitas”最初的意思，不是我们今天认为的“大学”，而是学生的法人团体。

construct.en: Stones from Aztec temples were used to construct churches and palaces and government buildings.
construct.zh: 阿兹特克神庙的石头被用来建造教堂、宫殿和政府大楼。

construct.en: It’s constructed from white marble and decorated with intricate carvings, calligraphy, and precious stones.
construct.zh: 它由白大理石建造，饰有复杂的雕刻、书法和宝石。

construct.en: The government constructed a large number of public houses, affordable public houses.
construct.zh: 政府建造了大量的公共住房，即经济实用的公共住房。

construct.en: The Great Wall was constructed over many centuries by different Chinese dynasties.
construct.zh: 长城是由中国不同朝代历时数百年修建的。

construct.en: The Olmec constructed ceremonial centers with large platforms, plazas and temples.
construct.zh: 奥尔梅克人建造了带有大型平台、广场和神庙的礼仪中心。

consecutive.en: In exchange for avoiding the death penalty, he was sentenced to eight consecutive life sentences without the possibility of parole.
consecutive.zh: 作为免于死刑的交换，他被判处八个连续终身监禁，且不得假释。

compute.en: One of the most prestigious awards in computing, the Turing Award, is named in his honor.
compute.zh: 计算机领域最负盛名的奖项之一——Turing Award，便是以他的名字命名的。

compute.en: It's computing it, creating something new in real time.
compute.zh: 它是在进行计算，实时创造出新的东西。

compute.en: Turing helped lay the foundations of modern computing.
compute.zh: Turing 奠定了现代计算机的基石。

compute.en: They solve search. They solve natural language computing.
compute.zh: 它们解决了搜索。它们解决了自然语言计算。

compute.en: They are a fundamental breakthrough in computing.
compute.zh: 它们是计算领域的一个根本性突破。

colonel.en: One such officer was Claus von Stauffenberg, a 36-year-old Lieutenant Colonel who had been awarded the Iron Cross for his bravery in the Battle of France.
colonel.zh: 其中一位军官是克劳斯·冯·施陶芬贝格（Claus von Stauffenberg），他是一名36岁的中校，曾在法兰西战役中因英勇表现而被授予铁十字勋章。

colonel.en: The focus quickly switched to a threat from within, and suspicion fell on the man who had entered with a briefcase, then quickly left without one: Lieutenant Colonel von Stauffenberg.
colonel.zh: 焦点迅速转移到来自内部的威胁，怀疑落在了那个提着公文包进来、随后又空手迅速离开的人身上：中校冯·施陶芬贝格。

colonel.en: Lumumba had clearly seen this potential, too, and promoted Mobutu to colonel and soon after, Chief of Staff of the national army - a meteoric rise that gave him enormous influence over the country’s only cohesive institution at the time.
colonel.zh: 卢蒙巴显然也看出了这种潜力，将蒙博托晋升为上校，不久后又任命他为国家军队参谋长——这是一次火箭般的升迁，使他对当时国内唯一的凝聚力机构产生了巨大的影响。

courteous.en: He had met Hitler on several occasions, and Hitler had always been polite and courteous to him; after all, the sacrifices this man had made for the Nazi cause were plain to see.
courteous.zh: 他曾多次见过希特勒，希特勒对他也总是彬彬有礼、客客气气；毕竟，这个人为了纳粹事业所做出的牺牲是有目共睹的。

commander.en: Lawrence rode for days through the desert to deliver the news to British commanders in Cairo.
commander.zh: Lawrence 骑马在沙漠中奔波了数日，将消息传达给开罗的英国指挥官。

commander.en: The transition from unknown boy to commander of the world’s most powerful empire at the time was incredibly smooth.
commander.zh: 从一个默默无闻的男孩转变为当时世界上最强大帝国的统帅，这个过渡异常平稳。

commander.en: A seasoned Roman commander, Publius Cornelius Scipio, fresh from victories in Iberia, led a daring campaign in North Africa.
commander.zh: 一位经验丰富的罗马统帅——刚在伊比利亚取得胜利的普布利乌斯·科尔内利乌斯·西庇阿（Publius Cornelius Scipio），在北非发起了一场大胆的远征。

commander.en: Arrest these supposedly rogue forces, declare martial law, and declare a Field Marshall called Erwin von Witzleben as Commander in Chief.
commander.zh: 逮捕这些所谓的反叛势力，宣布戒严，并宣布一位名叫埃尔温·冯·维茨莱本（Erwin von Witzleben）的元帅为总司令。

commander.en: In 1565, a military commander known as Estácio de Sá founded a new settlement for Portugal on the edge of the bay.
commander.zh: 1565年，一位名叫埃斯塔西奥·德·萨的军事指挥官在海湾边缘为葡萄牙建立了一个新的定居点。

communist.en: Those directly involved in the July 20th plot included nationalists, democrats, aristocrats and communists.
communist.zh: 直接参与7月20日阴谋的人包括民族主义者、民主主义者、贵族和共产主义者。

communist.en: But of course, Warsaw’s post-war identity, Warsaw’s story, was deeply influenced by communist politics.
communist.zh: 但当然，华沙战后的身份认同、华沙的故事，深受共产主义政治的影响。

communist.en: A new communist regime took power, and they were supported politically and militarily by Moscow.
communist.zh: 一个新的共产主义政权上台了，他们在政治和军事上得到了莫斯科的支持。

communist.en: And the continent was now divided between the “democratic” Western Europe and the “communist” Eastern Europe.
communist.zh: 而且，欧洲大陆现在分裂成了“民主的”西欧和“共产主义的”东欧。

communist.en: It represented the collapse of communist control in Eastern Europe.
communist.zh: 它代表了东欧共产主义控制的崩溃。

commute.en: We walk in our cities, shop in stores, and commute at stations without really thinking about how much we’re being watched.
commute.zh: 我们在城市中漫步，在商店里购物，在车站通勤，却根本不会去想自己被监视了多少。

commute.en: And then when I left that room to start sleeping at the gym, which was an hour away because I couldn't make the commute.
commute.zh: 然后当我离开那个房间开始睡在健身房时，那离我住的地方有一个小时的路程，因为我负担不起通勤费用。

commute.en: The situations in which they tend to be least happy are probably unsurprising: commuting, working in stressful conditions, or when they’re ill.
commute.zh: 他们最不快乐的场景可能并不令人意外：通勤、在压力山大的环境下工作，或者生病的时候。

collective.en: Collective security is the belief that all countries should work together to stop aggression and protect peace.
collective.zh: 集体安全是指这样一种信念：所有国家应当共同努力来制止侵略并保护和平。

collective.en: One of the main ideas was collective security.
collective.zh: 其中一个核心理念就是集体安全。

collective.en: By analysing billions of words on social media, or even the emotional tone of song lyrics, they attempt to track collective happiness in real time.
collective.zh: 通过分析社交媒体上的数十亿个单词，甚至是歌曲歌词的情感基调，他们试图实时追踪集体幸福感。

collective.en: Now they’re not. There are now huge opportunities for education and wealth in the country, and the Chinese government has even promoted the phrase the “Chinese Dream “, although it does tend to be a bit more on national success and collective progress
collective.zh: 而现在他们不再贫困了。中国现在拥有巨大的教育和财富机遇，中国政府甚至还推广了“中国梦”这一说法，尽管它往往更偏向于国家成功和集体进步。

correlate.en: Spending time with other people, perhaps unsurprisingly, is positively correlated with self-reported happiness.
correlate.zh: 不出所料，花时间与他人相处与自我报告的幸福感呈正相关。

correlate.en: And in the same report, household size is positively correlated with happiness, up to a point at least.
correlate.zh: 在同一份报告中，家庭规模与幸福感呈正相关，至少在一定程度上是这样。

compose.en: Once they composed themselves, perhaps they revealed a joke they'd just been told, or a funny story they had just heard about someone they knew.
compose.zh: 等他们平静下来后，也许会分享刚刚听到的一个笑话，或者关于他们认识某人的趣事。

consul.en: His consuls, who were sitting next to him, asked him why he was laughing.
consul.zh: 坐在他身旁的执政官问他为什么笑。

consul.en: Two Roman consuls, each commanding half of the force, led them out to finally crush Hannibal.
consul.zh: 两名罗马执政官各率领一半兵力，出征誓要彻底消灭Hannibal。

consul.en: These two consuls, two of the highest elected officials of the Roman Empire, presumably knew that Caligula was deadly serious.
consul.zh: 这两位执政官，作为罗马帝国职位最高elected officials中的两位，大概知道 Caligula 是绝对认真的。

contemporary.en: Aztec ruins lie beneath skyscrapers. Colonial churches stand beside contemporary museums.
contemporary.zh: 阿兹特克人的废墟静静躺在摩天大楼下方。殖民时期的教堂与当代博物馆比邻而立。

contemporary.en: And if you want to see the modern British food revival, go to a great gastropub or a contemporary British restaurant.
contemporary.zh: 如果你想见识现代英国食物的复兴，可以去一家棒极了的美食酒吧（gastropub）或现代英国餐厅。

contemporary.en: In any case, the first few months of his rule were, as one contemporary historian put it, a "Golden Age" of happiness and prosperity.
contemporary.zh: 无论如何，正如一位当代历史学家所说，他统治的头几个月是一个充满幸福和繁荣的“黄金时代”。

contemporary.en: I had to search online for common slang terms used today because I don’t really use much slang in my English, and I especially don’t use contemporary slang in my daily vocabulary.
contemporary.zh: 我不得不上网搜索今天常用的俚语词汇，因为我在英语中其实不太使用俚语，而且我的日常词汇中尤其不使用当代俚语。

contemporary.en: But the fact that, for example, iTunes and YouTube can put you in competition against your contemporaries every single day and make you go up and down and show you likes and comments and ratings.
contemporary.zh: 但事实上，比如说，iTunes和YouTube可以让你每天都与同龄人展开竞争，让你上下浮动，向你展示点赞、评论和评分。

congress.en: The Republican party in Texas wants to gain more seats in Congress.
congress.zh: 得克萨斯州的共和党希望在国会中获得更多席位。

congress.en: Congress would make the laws. The president would enforce the laws.
congress.zh: 国会制定法律。总统执行法律。

congress.en: Discretionary spending is the only category that is “optional”, which can be increased or decreased by Congress.
congress.zh: 可自由支配支出是唯一的“可选”类别，可以由国会增加或减少。

congress.en: This is often used in parliaments and congresses, when a party wants to stop a law from passing.
congress.zh: 这经常用于议会和国会，当一个政党想要阻止一项法律通过时。

consideration.en: So the fact that it took a lot of work wasn't, it wasn't even in, it wasn't in consideration at all.
consideration.zh: 你18、19岁的时候，是不是整天都在搞音乐？

consideration.en: There are a few other things I take into consideration too, like whether a story can be properly told in an audio-only format.
consideration.zh: 我还会考虑其他一些因素，比如一个故事是否适合仅通过音频形式来讲述。

consideration.en: A few years ago when this great Australian novelist named Gerald Murnane learned that he was nominated, he asked that his name be withdrawn from consideration.
consideration.zh: 几年前，当这位伟大的澳大利亚小说家 Gerald Murnane 得知自己被提名时，他要求撤回对他的提名资格。

consideration.en: The country was treated as a vast resource mine— rubber, copper, uranium, diamonds—all extracted for Belgian profit, with practically zero consideration for the livelihood or well-being of any of the native people.
consideration.zh: 这个国家被当作一个巨大的资源矿——橡胶、铜、铀、钻石——全部为比利时的利益而被疯狂掠夺，几乎完全不考虑任何当地人的生计或福祉。

consideration.en: Some, like if you are talking about works of art or geographical borders, just don’t work quite so well without images, so I’ll also take that into consideration, and that’s the reason there aren’t many episodes about art.
consideration.zh: 有些话题，比如艺术品或地理边界，如果没有图像就没那么好理解，所以我也会考虑到这一点，这也是为什么关于艺术的节目不多的原因。

conquer.en: Then there were the Gauls, the recently conquered or allied tribes from southern France.
conquer.zh: 还有高卢人，也就是刚刚被征服或归附的法国南部部落。

conquer.en: It is a city built on water. That was conquered, rebuilt, expanded, and modernized.
conquer.zh: 这是一座建立在水上的城市。它曾被征服、重建、扩建并现代化。

conquer.en: But across the ocean, another empire had begun to explore and conquer new lands.
conquer.zh: 但在海洋的另一端，另一个帝国已经开始探索并征服新的土地。

conquer.en: There was a time when every culture practically that was a conquering culture practiced slavery.
conquer.zh: 曾经有一段时间，几乎每个征服文化都实行奴隶制。

conquer.en: Some politicians in the US believed that conquering Canada would be easy.
conquer.zh: 美国的一些政客认为征服加拿大易如反掌。

costly.en: A siege, he knew, would be long and costly, and his army had never been particularly good at sieges.
costly.zh: 他深知围城战将旷日持久且代价高昂，而且他的军队向来不擅长攻城。

costly.en: These are unteachable lessons. No matter how arduous or costly or effortful it is going to be for us to find out ourselves, we prefer to disregard the mountains of warnings from our elders, songs, literature, historical catastrophes, public scandals, and instead think some version of, yeah, that might be true for them, but not for me.
costly.zh: 这些就是无法传授的课程。无论我们自己去发现它会有多么艰苦、昂贵或费力，我们都宁愿无视长辈、歌曲、文学、历史灾难、公共丑闻中堆积如山的警告，反而想出某种版本的：是的，那对他们来说可能是真的，但对我来说不是。

confrontation.en: Rather than face Hannibal in open battle, they avoided direct confrontation.
confrontation.zh: 他们不再与Hannibal进行正面决战，而是避免直接对抗。

confrontation.en: In some cultures, being too direct can sometimes sound rude or insensitive, so euphemisms are a way to avoid confrontation or embarrassment or discomfort.
confrontation.zh: 在某些文化中，过于直接有时听起来很粗鲁或缺乏同理心，所以委婉语是避免对抗、尴尬或不适的一种方式。

copper.en: Beneath the DRC lies enormous deposits of copper, cobalt, gold, diamonds, tin, and coltan.
copper.zh: 刚果（金）地下蕴藏着巨额的铜、钴、黄金、钻石、锡和钶钽铁矿储量。

copper.en: These include resources such as oil, natural gas, gold, diamonds, and copper.
copper.zh: 这些资源包括石油、天然气、黄金、钻石和铜等。

copper.en: And when there was a crash in the price of copper, which was one of Zaire’s main exports, the country literally ran out of money.
copper.zh: 当作为扎伊尔主要出口产品之一的铜价暴跌时，国家简直陷入了山穷水尽的地步。

copper.en: The Democratic Republic of Congo is one of the wealthiest countries in the world in terms of its natural resources, with huge deposits of copper, cobalt, gold, diamonds, and other precious metals.
copper.zh: 就自然资源而言，刚果民主共和国是世界上最富有的国家之一，拥有巨额的铜、钴、金、钻石和其他贵金属储量。

corrupt.en: Individual corruption happens when one person abuses their position, when one person is corrupt.
corrupt.zh: 个体腐败发生在一个个人滥用其职位、一个人出现腐败行为的时候。

corrupt.en: Enormous amounts of money can go missing through embezzlement or other corrupt practices.
corrupt.zh: 巨额资金会通过挪用公款或其他腐败行径凭空消失。

corrupt.en: Many young officers, including Mustafa Kemal, started to realise that the Ottoman system was outdated, corrupt, and incapable of modernising.
corrupt.zh: 许多年轻军官，包括穆斯塔法·凯末尔，开始意识到奥斯曼体系已经过时、腐败且无力实现现代化。

corrupt.en: So if a country discovers oil or other valuable materials, is it automatically going to become corrupt or economically dependent on that resource?
corrupt.zh: 因此，如果一个国家发现了石油或其他宝贵物质，它会自动变得腐败或在经济上依赖该资源吗？

corrupt.en: No. He was egregiously corrupt, and he and his allies siphoned off huge amounts of the country’s wealth and stashed it in Swiss banks and foreign property.
corrupt.zh: 不，他极其腐败，他和他的盟友掠夺了该国巨额财富，并将其藏在瑞士银行和外国房产中。

compensation.en: They even paid some money to the families, a token compensation payment by way of apology.
compensation.zh: 他们甚至向这些家庭支付了一些金钱，作为一种象征性的赔偿和道歉方式。

compensation.en: And only 10% of them or so were going to be promoted to their ultimate goal, which was to become a managing director, which is where much more serious compensation is received.
compensation.zh: 而其中只有大约10%的人，最终能晋升到他们的终极目标——成为董事总经理，也就是薪酬待遇远远更丰厚的那个位置。

consumption.en: It was a booming industry, and the average Roman senator’s daily perfume consumption would probably even put a member of the Kardashian family to shame.
consumption.zh: 这是一个蓬勃发展的行业，平均一个罗马参议员每天消耗的香水，大概会让卡戴珊（Kardashian）家族的成员都感到汗颜。

consumption.en: A phone was essentially a productive item, a productive asset, and not, as it really was seen in the West at the time, as a consumption good, a luxury good.
consumption.zh: 手机本质上是一件能产生生产力的东西、一项生产性资产，而不是像当时西方人看待的那样，是一种消费品、一种奢侈品。

consumption.en: I think modern AI. So just on that, one of my favorite takes is from Dworkash Patel, and he says, if you gave any human on the planet 0.001% of the consumption that LLM has, any LLM, they would have come up with thousands of new ideas.

conversion.zh: 正如你所想象的那样，这种皈依在他们的家族里并没有那么受欢迎。

conversion.en: He gets ministers who are in Zimbabwe in conversion missions that actually sign up for Econet service even though it doesn't exist yet, to kind of subsidize.
conversion.zh: 他找到那些正在津巴布韦传教的牧师们，让他们在Econet服务尚未真正开通之前就提前注册使用，相当于给这项服务提供一种补贴。

compel.en: And that's really compelling. That's like a motivational spit roasting coming in from both ends.
compel.zh: 这真的很吸引人。这就像是一种从两端同时袭来的动机烧烤。

compel.en: And this is what compelled me to do it. He said, what's the point in having fuck you freedom if you never say fuck you?
compel.zh: 这就是促使我去做这件事的原因。他说：“如果你从不说‘去你的’，那么拥有‘去你的’自由有什么意义？”

compel.en: I feel like I wake up and I'm like compelled or like I don't even know the word to use it like then there's no doubt that I'm just on the right path if I was sitting here and we weren't recording and I was just seeking your advice like I don't feel it's at work at all the only time it feels like work is when I have to edit which I fucking hate but I do it anyways because I think it makes it better yeah but that's the only example it's a good example there are parts of it that are not always fun.

constrain.en: You know, it's nonsense. And it also constrains my time and it's just work.
constrain.zh: 你知道，这很荒谬。而且它限制了我的时间，这纯粹是工作。

constrain.en: You really want to think it through because where you live really constrains and defines your opportunities.
constrain.zh: 你真的需要深思熟虑，因为你居住的地方极大地限制并定义了你的机会。

constrain.en: And not only was the music great, but I loved you describing what went into making it. we can talk about that but there was something like a the way i would like uh still down what you were saying is like constraints are actually your friend yeah if you don't like you can't do everything so if you if you artificially constrain yourself you can't you it forces you to be more creative can you talk about this i feel like you've used this a bunch in your career yeah it's like the idea of creating a palette and the albums that speak to me most are ones when you hear them, you know, if an artist has 20 albums, but you hear a song, you know, oh, that has to be on that album, that seventh album, because that's the only album that sounds like that.
constrain.zh: 不仅音乐很棒，而且我很喜欢你描述制作过程的方式。我们可以谈谈那个，但你所说的有一种……我把它总结为‘限制其实是你的朋友’。是的，如果你不喜欢……你不能做所有事情，所以如果你人为地限制自己，它会迫使你更有创造力。你能谈谈这个吗？我觉得你在职业生涯中多次使用过这个方法。

couch.en: They're going to sit on the couch and you're just going to be.
couch.zh: 他们会坐在沙发上，你们就只是待着。

couch.en: And he sits in the back and you almost, it goes on long enough where you forget he's even there because he's just silent in the corner, listening, sitting on a couch, listening over and over again.
couch.zh: 他坐在后面，你几乎……时间久了你都会忘了他在那儿，因为他只是安静地坐在角落里，听着，坐在沙发上，一遍又一遍地听。

counsel.en: And it starts out with him coming to seek your counsel.
counsel.zh: 开头就是他来寻求你的建议。

counsel.en: There's a ton of people that come to seek your counsel.
counsel.zh: 有很多人来寻求你的建议。

complement.en: Again, I think happiness and focus and success can kind of complement each other.
complement.zh: 再次重申，我认为快乐、专注和成功是可以相辅相成的。

compliment.en: And so when I would have a brother compliment me, getting male praise was kind of intoxicating.
compliment.zh: 所以当有弟兄称赞我时，得到男性的赞美简直让人陶醉。

compliment.en: This is not you know, one of those just dropping compliments type thing eventually that people will see through that.
compliment.zh: 这不是那种……你知道，那种随便抛出赞美之类的事情，人们最终会看穿的。

compliment.en: I heard this second hand, so I could be wrong, but I like the story where they get up and they start speaking and the people in the audience are only allowed to compliment them, genuine compliments, not fake compliments, on things that they did well, but you're not allowed to criticize them on things that they did poorly and eventually they kind of get through it and they develop self-confidence.
compliment.zh: 我是二手听说的，所以我可能是错的，但我喜欢这个故事：他们站起来开始演讲，观众只被允许称赞他们，真诚的称赞，不是虚假的称赞，称赞他们做得好的地方，但不允许批评他们做得不好的地方。最终他们克服了，并建立了自信。

compact.en: Then you take care of your extended family, you take care of your cousins, brothers, uncles, grandmothers, aunts, sisters, everybody that you can. and then if you have more resources beyond that then you go take care of your local tribe you take care of your people you start trying to do some good for the world and if you have more resources than that you go take care of an even bigger tribe and that's how you earn both respect and self-confidence and you live up to your potential so the the more you have the more is rightfully expected of you and i think it's a good compact with society when highly capable people express and flex that capability by giving more and more and by doing more and more and society rewards them with the one thing they can't get otherwise, which is status.
compact.zh: 然后你照顾你的大家庭，照顾你的堂表亲、兄弟、叔叔、祖母、阿姨、姐妹，所有你能照顾的人。如果在此之外你还有更多资源，那么你就去照顾你的当地部落，照顾你的人民，开始尝试为世界做点好事。如果你拥有的资源比那还多，你就去照顾一个更大的部落，这就是你赢得尊重和自信的方式，你才能发挥出你的潜力。所以你拥有的越多，人们理所当然对你的期望就越高。我认为当高能力的人通过给予更多、做更多来表达和展示这种能力时，这与社会达成了一种良好的契约，而社会则用他们无法通过其他方式获得的东西来奖励他们，那就是地位。

coward.en: There's no way that it could happen. I might be a coward.
coward.zh: 绝对不能让这种事发生。我可能只是个懦夫。

compression.en: And so my time compression of when I thought I should start doing something and when I started doing it over time, it's just compressed to the point where it's like the moment I think that I need to start doing it.
compression.zh: 所以我的时间压缩，从我以为我应该开始做某事到我开始做它，随着时间的推移，它已经压缩到就像我想到我需要开始做它的那一刻。

contaminate.en: Avoid tunnel vision. Keep difficult things in one part of your life from contaminating everything else.
contaminate.zh: 避免管窥效应。把生活中某个部分的难题与其余部分隔离开来。

cordial.en: It was a sad situation. Denise says when Betsy DeVos came to school, with the teachers, she was cordial, but not overly friendly.
cordial.zh: 那是个让人难过的状况。Denise说，当Betsy DeVos来到学校时，她对老师们很客气，但并不算十分亲切。

corresponding.en: Will recalled the details, what the different Jehovah's Witness books were called and their corresponding colors, the meetings, the designations of all the elders.
corresponding.zh: Will回忆起各种细节，不同耶和华见证人书籍的名称及对应的颜色，聚会，所有长老的头衔。
